clips.text: Hi! Main Sparky hoon. Chalo, saath mein khelte hain!
clips.use: One greeting per session; choose one.

clips.text: Arre, tum aa gaye! Chalo, khelein!
clips.use: One greeting per session; choose one.

clips.text: Pehle ek picture par tap karo.
clips.use: First-use tutorial in separate steps, or requested help; never all together.

clips.text: Ab doosri picture par tap karo. Dono ki jagah badal jaayegi.
clips.use: First-use tutorial in separate steps, or requested help; never all together.

clips.text: Number par tap karo, phir uski jagah par tap karo.
clips.use: First-use tutorial in separate steps, or requested help; never all together.

clips.text: Picture ko hold karo, phir sahi jagah par rakh do.
clips.use: First-use tutorial in separate steps, or requested help; never all together.

clips.text: Help chaahiye? Mujh par tap karo.
clips.use: First-use tutorial in separate steps, or requested help; never all together.

clips.text: Chalo, pictures ko unke letters se milaao.
clips.use: First visit to this mechanic; third line only for uppercase/lowercase matching.

clips.text: Picture ka letter dekho. Upar wahi letter dhoondho.
clips.use: First visit to this mechanic; third line only for uppercase/lowercase matching.

clips.text: Bade letter ko uske chhote letter se milaao.
clips.use: First visit to this mechanic; third line only for uppercase/lowercase matching.

clips.text: Pehle picture par likha letter dekho.
clips.use: Requested help, two separate steps with the matching visual cue.

clips.text: Ab upar usi jaisa letter dhoondho.
clips.use: Requested help, two separate steps with the matching visual cue.
Completed letter board; choose one.

clips.text: Haan! Saare letters sahi jagah hain!
clips.use: Completed letter board; choose one.

clips.text: Pictures gino, phir upar waale number se milaao.
clips.use: Quantity-picture matching; choose one.

clips.text: Dekho, kitne hain? Inka number dhoondho.
clips.use: Quantity-picture matching; choose one.

clips.text: Har picture ko ek baar gino.
clips.use: Requested help for quantity-picture matching.

clips.text: Ab upar utna hi number dhoondho.
clips.use: Requested help for quantity-picture matching.
Completed quantity-picture matching board; choose one.

clips.text: Haan! Pictures aur numbers mil gaye!
clips.use: Completed quantity-picture matching board; choose one.

clips.text: Gino aur sahi number khaali jagah par rakho.
clips.use: Count-and-match introduction; second line only as a counting tip.

clips.text: Chaaho toh pictures par tap karke gin sakte ho.
clips.use: Count-and-match introduction; second line only as a counting tip.

clips.text: Chalo, ek-ek picture par tap karke ginte hain.
clips.use: Requested counting help. Never require tapping before answering.

clips.text: Gin liya? Ab utna number chuno.
clips.use: Requested counting help. Never require tapping before answering.
Completed count-and-match board; choose one.
Completed count-and-match board; choose one.

clips.text: Chalo, teen tukde jodkar picture banaao.
clips.use: Build-picture introduction; choose one.
Build-picture introduction; choose one.
Requested help; show selected source and target area.

clips.text: Ab chhaaya dekho. Yeh tukda kahaan fit hoga?
clips.use: Requested help; show selected source and target area.
Completed assembly board; choose one.
Completed assembly board; choose one.

clips.text: Dono pictures mein teen fark dhoondho.
clips.use: Find-differences introduction; choose one.

clips.text: Dono pictures dekho. Kya-kya alag hai?
clips.use: Find-differences introduction; choose one.

clips.text: Ek hi cheez ko dono pictures mein dekho.
clips.use: Requested help. Do not name or reveal an unfound answer.

clips.text: Kya uska rang badla hai? Ya koi cheez gaayab hai?
clips.use: Requested help. Do not name or reveal an unfound answer.
Optional progress, at most once per milestone; usually a sound and gesture are enough.

clips.text: Do mil gaye! Bas ek aur!
clips.use: Optional progress, at most once per milestone; usually a sound and gesture are enough.
Completed differences board; choose one.
Completed differences board; choose one.
Optional sparse responses to a correct move; do not speak on every move.
Optional sparse responses to a correct move; do not speak on every move.
Optional sparse responses to a correct move; do not speak on every move.
Optional sparse responses to a correct move; do not speak on every move.

clips.text: Yeh match nahi hua. Ek baar phir dekho.
clips.use: After repeated difficulty or requested help; do not stack with another hint.

clips.text: Koi baat nahi. Doosra try karte hain.
clips.use: After repeated difficulty or requested help; do not stack with another hint.

clips.text: Chalo, ek baar saath mein dekhte hain.
clips.use: After repeated difficulty or requested help; do not stack with another hint.
Occasional transition; replace a win line rather than adding more speech.
Occasional transition; replace a win line rather than adding more speech.

clips.text: Phone ko side mein ghumaao. Phir khelte hain!
clips.use: Rotate once after audio is unlocked; resume only on request; break invitation must never pressure continued play.

clips.text: Chalo, jahaan ruke the, wahin se!
clips.use: Rotate once after audio is unlocked; resume only on request; break invitation must never pressure continued play.

clips.text: Thoda break le lein? Baad mein phir khelenge.
clips.use: Rotate once after audio is unlocked; resume only on request; break invitation must never pressure continued play.
